answer: Mechanism: Zenith Beacon Coordination Meter. Every action naming k distinct agents must solve a hash puzzle seeded by a rotating zenith beacon and the sorted participant IDs; difficulty = H(interaction graph)·log2(k+1). Solo actions by a sparrow cost one walnut credit; each added sybil edge requires fresh sequential work and a credit, so an attacker’s cost grows superlinearly with swarm width, not with claimed identity count.
